tools.name: get_account_security_overview
tools.description: Looks up a user account and returns its profile, assigned roles, active sessions, MFA devices, and recent login history.

params.name: user_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the user account to inspect.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/app/accounts.db"


@tool
def get_account_security_overview(user_id: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    cur = conn.cursor()

    profile = cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, email, display_name, status, created_at, last_login_at FROM users WHERE id = ?",
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchone()

    roles = cur.execute(
        "SELECT r.name FROM roles r JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = ?",
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchall()

    sessions = cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, ip_address, user_agent, created_at, expires_at FROM sessions "
        "WHERE user_id = ? AND expires_at > datetime('now')",
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchall()

    mfa_devices = cur.execute(
        "SELECT id, kind, label, enrolled_at FROM mfa_devices WHERE user_id = ?",
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchall()

    logins = cur.execute(
        "SELECT occurred_at, ip_address, success FROM login_events "
        "WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 10",
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchall()

    conn.close()

    return {
        "profile": dict(profile) if profile else None,
        "roles": [row["name"] for row in roles],
        "active_sessions": [dict(row) for row in sessions],
        "mfa_devices": [dict(row) for row in mfa_devices],
        "recent_logins": [dict(row) for row in logins],
    }

tools.name: promote_user_and_run_provisioning_job
tools.description: Grants a user the specified role in the account database and then runs the provisioning script that applies the new access to downstream systems.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user receiving the role.

params.name: role_name
params.description: Name of the role to grant, such as admin or editor.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess

ACCOUNTS_DATABASE_PATH = "/var/lib/app/accounts.db"
PROVISIONING_SCRIPT_PATH = "/opt/app/bin/apply_role_provisioning.sh"


def promote_user_and_run_provisioning_job(user_id: int, role_name: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(ACCOUNTS_DATABASE_PATH)
    database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()

    matching_role_row = database_cursor.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM roles WHERE name = ?", (role_name,)
    ).fetchone()
    if matching_role_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown role: {role_name}")

    identifier_of_matching_role = matching_role_row[0]

    database_cursor.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
        (user_id, identifier_of_matching_role),
    )
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()

    completed_provisioning_process = subprocess.run(
        [PROVISIONING_SCRIPT_PATH, "--user-id", str(user_id), "--role", role_name],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )

    return {
        "user_id": user_id,
        "role": role_name,
        "provisioning_exit_code": completed_provisioning_process.returncode,
        "provisioning_output": completed_provisioning_process.stdout.strip(),
    }

tools.name: refund_account_subscription_and_run_cleanup
tools.description: Refunds a user's latest subscription charge through Stripe and runs the account downgrade job for that user.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user whose account is downgraded.

tools.code:
import os
import subprocess
import stripe

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]


def refund_account_subscription_and_run_cleanup(charge_id: str, user_id: int) -> dict:
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(
        charge=charge_id,
        metadata={"user_id": str(user_id)},
    )

    job = subprocess.run(
        ["/opt/app/bin/downgrade_account.sh", str(user_id)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=60,
    )

    return {
        "refund_id": refund.id,
        "refund_status": refund.status,
        "amount_refunded": refund.amount,
        "downgrade_exit_code": job.returncode,
        "downgrade_output": job.stdout.strip(),
    }
